title: amico pack manifest
description: The unit of generality for a domain pack (autoresearch studio WS1, #369): one manifest per domain bundling skills, a template registry, the corrector with its integrity manifest, the catalog schema, the onboarding score, and an eval corpus pointer. Owned by the schema package; one validator consumed by the extension, the CLI, and CI. A score is one FIELD of a pack, not a peer of it. The per-entry tier (open vs an entitlement bundle id) encodes the open-core boundary: flowing a feature back to open-source is a manifest edit plus a content move, not a migration. Pack ids are deliberately NOT an enum — the taxonomy is manifest data, revisable without a schema version bump.

id.description: pack id, kebab-case, free-form (quantum-control, qec, calibration, ...)

version.description: pack content version — bump when content moves between tiers

scores.description: score dirs this pack contributes, relative to the pack dir

primary.description: score id compiled as the spine (score #0)

head.description: optional chain head (e.g. overture): when present and routing says onboard, head ++ primary compile as ONE chained section

skills.description: skill dirs this pack contributes, relative to the pack dir

templates.description: template registry: name → tiered path (e.g. solve → the vetted template)

paths.description: the gate artifacts — must resolve OUTSIDE agent-editable trees (a load-time property, not a convention)

integrity.description: path to the sha256 integrity manifest covering every named path, relative to the pack dir

catalog_schema.description: registered schema kind for this pack's catalog entries (e.g. catalog-entry)

eval_corpus.description: pointer to the pack's eval corpus (e.g. a Prova corpus ref)

tier.description: open (default when absent), or the entitlement bundle id gating this entry
